_for: ㅋㅋ상회 soominiverse 양식 사진 게시물 5개 (2026-11-22 00시). 글씨는 humor-cards에서 직접 얹는다.
style: Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, signs with writing, or logos anywhere in the image. Original characters only, not resembling any real person or existing franchise.

prompts.name: kk_s01_selfie
prompts.prompt: Black and white pen-and-ink manga illustration with fine hatching, like a Korean exam textbook illustration. A cafe table: on the left, a young Korean man slumps, staring at his phone screen full of selfie thumbnails (blank squares), looking defeated. On the right, his friend sits with arms crossed, looking at him with a deadpan, unimpressed face. Leave empty space in the upper left area above the slumped man's head.

prompts.name: kk_s02_payday
prompts.prompt: Black and white pen-and-ink manga illustration with fine hatching, like a Korean exam textbook illustration. A small studio apartment: a young Korean woman sits on the floor surrounded by many opened delivery boxes and shopping bags, holding a phone and staring at it in shock. Her friend stands behind her holding a coffee, looking down at the boxes with a flat expression. Leave empty space in the upper left area.

prompts.name: kk_s03_mandu
prompts.prompt: Simple cute minimal illustration on a plain white background, soft pastel colors, thick soft outlines. Two chubby steamed dumplings (mandu) with tiny arms and simple dot-eye faces stand side by side in the lower half of the frame. The left dumpling looks up hopefully with sparkly eyes, leaning in for a hug. The right dumpling looks away with a calm, slightly cold expression, one tiny hand raised like stop. The whole upper 40 percent of the image is empty white space.

prompts.name: kk_s04_groupchat
prompts.prompt: Soft colored Korean webtoon illustration, warm night lighting. A young Korean woman lies in bed under a blanket at night, holding her phone close to her face, eyes wide with dramatic anxiety, sweat drops, mouth slightly open in panic, as if overthinking a tiny message. Cozy bedroom, dark window. Leave large empty space in the upper third of the image above her.

prompts.name: kk_s05_penguin
prompts.prompt: Soft painterly storybook illustration, gentle pastel blue and white tones. On a snowy ice field during light snowfall, two penguins stand close together. The smaller penguin looks up at the bigger one with a shy, curious face. The bigger penguin leans its body slightly to shield the smaller one from the wind, looking ahead calmly. Emotional, quiet, heartwarming mood. Leave large empty space in the upper half of the image (soft snowy sky).
